verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents dynamic (rule-based) group membership or assigning apps to groups. SCIM docs describe provisioning users and groups into downstream apps, which is a different capability. Lifecycle workflows and access packages are adjacent governance features, not rule-driven group assignment. Directory access assignment is clearly an applicable axis for an identity directory, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an IT admin, access is assigned by group and rule — dynamic group membership and group-based app assignment replace one-by-one grants
